question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Substances**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Substances **refer to the physical matter or material that makes up something. (वह भौतिक पदार्थ या सामग्री जिससे कोई चीज़ बनती है) • **Example**: *The scientist carefully measured the remaining sugar substance in the test tube.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank in the given sentence. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Contents**: This refers to what is contained within something, such as the contents of a book or a bottle. (किसी चीज़ के भीतर समाहित) • **Essences**: This refers to the intrinsic nature or indispensable quality of something, such as the essence of a perfume or the essence of an argument. (किसी चीज़ की आंतरिक प्रकृति या अपरिहार्य गुण) • **Compositions**: This refers to the way in which something is made up or arranged, such as the composition of a painting or a musical composition. (वह तरीका जिससे कोई चीज़ बनाई या व्यवस्थित की जाती है) 4b:T991, The correct answer is: **Harming**
